key_insight: Healthcare LLMs need evaluation methods tailored to open-ended, probabilistic, and context-sensitive behavior rather than traditional ML alone.
clinical_relevance: Rigorous evaluation helps ensure LLMs in medicine improve care safely and reliably instead of producing misleading or harmful outputs.
method: Study-design principles for aligning evaluation with the research question
Capability benchmarks: multiple-choice, agentic, and multi-turn tests
Clinical-context checks: human review, LLM-as-a-judge, and clinical trials
evidence_signal: This review synthesizes evaluation approaches rather than reporting new experimental data, focusing on benchmarks, operational metrics like token usage, and methods for assessing free-text accuracy.
watch_item: Evaluation results can change with prompt design and accumulated context, so comparisons may be unstable if testing conditions are not standardized.
paper_title: A primer on evaluation methods for large language models in healthcare
